notes.title: New Trailer and Xbox Release!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Exciting news! We've just launched the new teaser trailer for our game Scarlet Deer Inn at ID@Xbox Showcase. If you missed it, don't worry – you can check it out now!
And we've got new screenshots too! 

[previewyoutube=Ra-ZDYAwCV4;full][/previewyoutube]
And here's the big news – Scarlet Deer Inn will also be available on Xbox, along with Steam and Nintendo Switch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39879521/9c9ed7e61204f19c6167f1c6df95c62f197a88fa.png
ABOUT:
Scarlet Deer Inn is an embroidered narrative platformer with an emotional story, an interesting cast of characters, a dark dungeon full of monsters, and a world inspired by Slavic folklore. The only thing protecting you from certain death is your torch. All character images are actually embroidered, and we create the music ourselves using traditional instruments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39879521/968f20c83d5a34c98a312729b97af4d5d7e80023.png
If you would like to help us by sharing the news, that would be awesome and we would really appreciate it! 

Stay tuned for more updates.


Have a nice day!
Eva and Lukas from Attu Games
